svg.title: Agent-T product positioning
svg.desc: Agent-T is an evidence-driven, rule-grounded, human-accountable contract-review Agent.
svg.text: Agent-T is a contract-review Agent product

g.text: It delivers its service through a traditional web application and uses deterministic rules
to produce formal review findings. Multiple AI modules surface doubts and objections,
while bounded verification, human confirmation, and re-verification form the Agent loop.
Evidence, budgets, rules, and human confirmation strictly limit its autonomy.
